items.question: What are Emma Meesseman's stats?
items.answer: In the 2025 regular season, Emma Meesseman averaged 13.4 points, 5.1 rebounds, and 3.2 assists in 17 games for the New York Liberty.

items.question: Who has Emma Meesseman played for in the WNBA?
items.answer: Emma Meesseman has played for the Washington Mystics, Chicago Sky and New York Liberty. Washington drafted her 19th overall in 2013, she made the All-Star team with the Mystics in 2015 and with the Sky in 2022, and she played for the Liberty in 2025.

items.question: How tall is Emma Meesseman?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Emma Meesseman at 6 feet 4 inches and 191 pounds.

items.question: How old is Emma Meesseman?
items.answer: Emma Meesseman was born May 13, 1993. She is from Belgium.

items.question: Did Emma Meesseman win WNBA Finals MVP?
items.answer: Yes. Emma Meesseman was named 2019 WNBA Finals MVP after helping the Washington Mystics win the franchise's first title. She averaged 17.8 points in the series and became the first reserve in WNBA history to win the award.

items.question: What position does Emma Meesseman play?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Emma Meesseman as a forward, and she also plays center. Her WNBA bio describes her as a 6-4 center from Belgium.

items.question: Has Emma Meesseman played in the Olympics?
items.answer: Yes. Emma Meesseman played for Belgium at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics and at Paris 2024, where she made the tournament All-Star Five and Belgium finished fourth.

items.question: Did Emma Meesseman win EuroBasket?
items.answer: Yes. Emma Meesseman led Belgium to its first FIBA Women's EuroBasket title in 2023 and was named the tournament MVP.
